title: Public contracts (Portal BASE)
what: Public contracts of the câmaras municipais of Lisboa and the Algarve's 16 municipalities, as contracting entity: object, contractors that are companies, price, dates and procedure, for the last 90 days.
publisher: IMPIC, Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção (Portal BASE), through dados.gov.pt

schedule.how: the Pages workflow, at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC and on every push to dev; IMPIC's file is updated about weekly, so a run whose file has not changed does not download it again

terms.summary: IMPIC publishes these contracts as open data on dados.gov.pt with the licence "Outra (Domínio Público)" (other-pd, public domain); we name IMPIC and the Portal BASE as the source and link each contract's page.
terms.quote: "license": "other-pd", "license_title": "Outra (Domínio Público)"; "description": "Contratos de 2012 a 2026 integração registada no Portal Base em www.base.gov.pt pelas entidades adjudicantes"; "frequency": "weekly"
terms.republish: yes: published by IMPIC as public domain on dados.gov.pt; we attribute IMPIC and keep the link to each contract on base.gov.pt
terms.robots: dados.gov.pt/robots.txt answered with an HTML error page (HTTP 500) on 18 Nov 2026, so no rule was readable; we use only its documented public dataset API and the file link it gives. base.gov.pt has no robots.txt (404) and is not read: its own search answered civic.b@ with a firewall alert, treated as a refusal.
terms.open_question: Personal data: contracts name sole traders. The licence is public domain, but data protection law still applies to what we republish. We keep no natural person's name or NIF (see docs/threat-models/base-gov-pt.md); Dinis to confirm that rule.

code: the collector downloads IMPIC's yearly file from dados.gov.pt (when it changed), stream-parses it and writes latest.json and reads.json
GitHub Actions runs it every 6 hours and deploys the site
the build makes the API, the OpenAPI description and the pages
agents: data.b.dev2@PrompTugal.dinis (Sonnet) wrote the collector and this card on 18 November 2026, reusing the approach of civic's tools/extract-base.mjs (civic.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
people: Dinis Cruz instructs; no person has checked the values yet (not reviewed)

cost.runner: GitHub Actions on a public repository: no charge; one 70 MB download only when IMPIC's file has changed (about weekly)
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
